label: Avatar
description: A round avatar that shows a photo when it has one and the person's initials when it does not — sized by a single Size input, and ringed so a stack of them stays legible against any background. Avatar Group overlaps them the way you expect and collapses the tail into a "+3" badge once Max is set. Out of the box the group renders five sample people from a Static Data node; connect your own array (Name/Image per item) to Items and it wins over the samples.
